whatGetsCreated.title: What Gets Created
whatGetsCreated.description: The tool automatically generates the following in Revit:

items.title: Walls
items.description: Structural walls based on detected lines and thickness

items.title: Doors
items.description: Door instances with appropriate sizes and materials

features.title: Key Features
items: Door and window recognition with type assignment
Room boundary detection and area calculation
Dimension extraction and coordinate system setup
Material assignment based on detected patterns
Dynamo script generation for further automation
DWG export for compatibility with other tools

tips.title: Tips for Best Results
items: Ensure clear walls with distinct line styles
Mark doors and windows clearly in the original image
Include proper scale or dimension information
Use consistent line weights for accuracy
Test with a single floor before processing multi-story plans
Have Revit templates ready before import
Keep original floor plan for reference during review
